notes: Original authored geometry and physical material synthesis; the music-box portrait and title use the user-supplied reference photographs. Hardware and impact damage are geometry, and the case remains closed.

Bank collision reads the same triangle vertices as the exported visual surface. Irregular rim outcrops share their exact base polygons with physical foot collision; the exposed viewing notch is intentionally open.
Actual water, refraction, depth extinction and submerged real-headlamp scattering belong to the world compositor; this pack supplies no opaque sea plane.
The sunk vehicle uses the actual shared driving van asset and its loaded headlamp, tyre and cabin anchors in scene.js, with one shared settled body matrix. No generic-van anchor fallback is retained.
The anonymous note has independent UV0..1 and .14x.10m dimensions; final narrative ink is host-owned.
Grass and soil use larger physical tiles with band-limited correlated relief, not per-pixel height noise. Albedo bases remain unchanged; lighting is calibrated in the real compositor.
All coast instances disable the generic outdoor yard branch and use one explicit broad cloud-filtered moon plus actual practicals.
Geometry/material contracts do not prove final native perception or human fear/comfort.
